why: The same guard rewritten to `orientation`, which asks which frame the scope stands in. A drawing's frames are the author's own `turn` and `mirror` at the `use` that pushes them, so the answer is already written in the document and a guard on it would test the document against itself. Refused where it is written, which is why neither `Cond::orientation` nor the `Mirror` it carries can be bound by any drawing.
